title: TelemetrySeries
description: One telemetry series (ADR 0056 Amendment 1, plane 6): the identity of a metric trend about ONE subject, and the owner-namespaced event stream its points are appended to. Identity is (owner, producing principal, subject, scope, metric name, unit), committed by `identity_digest` and carried in `series_id`; a series never changes identity, and a different metric, unit or subject is a different series. Points are appended to `stream_id` through the event-stream plane under the classes its `event_class_declaration` names: `telemetry.point` is ADMITTED truth (read from an admitted record, required to replay the series, receipted) and `telemetry.sample` is EPHEMERAL delivery (a sample of a changing value: no sequence, head, root or receipt, held only in the daemon's bounded in-process window, gone at restart). Metric names and units adopt OpenTelemetry semantic conventions where one fits and use the `ioi.` namespace where none does; `metric.semantic_convention` says which. A series grants nothing and is never authority.

series_id.description: ts_ plus the first 16 hex characters of identity_digest.

identity_digest.description: sha256 over the JCS bytes of {owner_ref, producer_principal_ref, subject_ref, scope_ref, metric_name, metric_unit}.

subject_ref.description: The one thing the series measures: a System, an automation or one of its runs, an environment, an agent, a health check, a session.

scope_ref.description: The System the subject serves, when it serves one (a check that observes the System, a run of an automation installed for it); null otherwise.

name.description: An OpenTelemetry-style metric name: lowercase, dot-namespaced.

unit.description: A UCUM case-sensitive unit as OpenTelemetry uses it: `1` for a dimensionless value, `s` for seconds, `{token}` for an annotated count.

instrument.description: The OpenTelemetry instrument kind the measurements are recorded with; it decides how points aggregate.

registry.description: Whose naming the metric follows: an OpenTelemetry semantic convention, or an `ioi.` name where no OpenTelemetry convention fits.

reference.description: Where the convention is defined: an OpenTelemetry semantic-conventions URL, or the canon anchor for an `ioi.` name.

stream_id.description: The owner-namespaced event stream the series' points are appended to — one stream per series in the hypervisor-telemetry namespace.

event_class_declaration.description: The stream's declared event classes, exactly as admitted in its genesis operation.

ephemeral_window.description: Where ephemeral samples live: in the daemon process only, newest window_points kept. They do not survive a restart and carry no receipt.

producer_ref.description: The daemon producer that emits the series' points (for example daemon-producer://health-check-evaluate).

producer_principal_ref.description: The signed-in principal whose request produced the points. It is part of the series identity: the event-stream plane admits appends only from the principal that reserved the stream.

declaration_receipt_ref.description: The receipt of the series' admitted declaration.

latest_point.description: A projection of the newest appended point, for listings; the range read is the truth.
